Commentary.Commentary: That is it from this game! But hold on, do not go anywhere as the next game will begin shortly where Pakistan is set to face Namibia. That game will begin at 6 pm local (2 pm GMT). Switch tabs and we hope to see you there!

Temba Bavuma, the skipper of South Africa, says that it was a good day for them. Mentions that Rabada and Norje exploited the conditions well. Tells that they are blessed to have bowlers like them in the team. Adds that they wanted to get to the target early but the ball was still nipping around when he went in. Informs that they have a big game coming up against England and they need to play their best cricket.

Mahmudullah, the skipper of Bangladesh, says the wicket was pretty good to bowl on but it was poor batting from them. Adds that Taskin Ahmed has been bowling really well for them and they wanted to give more chances to him. Tells that they are disappointed as they were close to winning two games but unfortunately were not able to do so.

Kagiso Rabada is the Player of the Match. He says that the wicket favoured the seamers and he is glad that it was his day. Adds that they train hard and it finally paid off. Tells that it was not a surprise that the ball moved so much as it did help the bowlers in the Indian T20 league as well. Says that he is happy for Anrich Nortje and he feels good to be bowling alongside him.
Presentation time...

Earlier in the day, after electing to bowl, brilliant performances from Nortje and Rabada restricted Bangladesh to a very low score. South Africa too had problems against the new ball as they lost three at the start but they ended up chasing it quiet easily.

Bangladesh needed a miracle to defend this. They did start off well by dismissing the top order cheaply but one partnership is all that South Africa needed and they got that as Bavuma and Rassie constructed a stand close to victory which took them to the brink of victory. Rassie fell but Miller and Bavuma ensured there were no more wickets to fall and took their side over the line.

Bangladesh can be happy with the fact that they did not make run scoring very easy. Especially Taskin and Shoriful who were really good with the new ball but they needed to keep picking up wickets and once the ball got old, their bowlers got less effective. To be honest, they just did not have enough runs on the board.

Bangladesh needed a miracle to defend this. They did start off well by dismissing the top order cheaply but one partnership is all that South Africa needed and they got that as Bavuma and Rassie constructed a 50-plus stand. The two started off slowly but scored freely as the innings progressed and took their side over the line.
FOUR! Miller hits the winning runs! This is full, on middle. David Miller smacks it towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary. SOUTH AFRICA WIN BY 6 WICKETS!
On the pads, Bavuma tucks it to short fine leg for a sharp single.
Outside off, David Miller drags it down to long off for a single.
David Miller walks out to bat. Also, Mahedi Hasan is back into the attack.

OUT! TAKEN! A stunner from Shoriful Islam running backwards from mid on! Loopy ball, on middle. Rassie van der Dussen uses his feet again and takes the aerial route. He wanted to finish the game but perishes. Skies it towards long on. Shoriful Islam runs back and grabs a blinder. Kept his eyes under the ball right till the end and pouches it in the end.
Commentary.Howout: c Shoriful Islam b Nasum Ahmed

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Rassie van der Dussen takes on the bowler now! Floats it up, on leg. Rassie van der Dussen uses his feet and heaves it to the vacant long on region for a boundary.
Full and on the pads, clipped to mid on for a run.
FOUR! Streaky! Short and outside off, Temba Bavuma hangs back and looks to cut. The ball goes off the outside edge towards third man for a boundary.
Full and outside off, steered to point.
WIDE! Down the leg side. Temba Bavuma leaves it alone. Wided.
Loopy ball, on middle. Rassie van der Dussen steps out and whips it through mid-wicket. The fielder gives it a chase and keeps it down to three runs.
This is shorter in length, around off. Temba Bavuma stays back to block it to cover. 18 runs needed off 48 balls.
FOUR! Temba Bavuma gets hold of one now! Good-length ball, around off. Bavuma stands tall and lofts it over mid on for a boundary.
Good-length ball, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen drives on the up towards mid off. Mahmudullah there runs to his left and puts in a dive to stop the ball. A single taken.
Back of a length, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen punches off the back foot but straight to the cover fielder.
Slower ball, on a length, around off. Temba Bavuma pushes it to mid on and takes off for a single.
Good-length ball, angling in from middle. Rassie van der Dussen tucks it to deep square leg for a run.
Soumya Sarkar to roll his arm now.
Flatter ball, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen cuts it past point and keeps the strike for the next over. 25 runs needed off 54 balls now!
Loopy ball, on middle. Temba Bavuma works it to long on. The batters cross for a run.
Well bowled! Floated, outside off. Temba Bavuma looks to defend but he misses and the ball zips past his outside edge.
Tossed up, around middle. Rassie van der Dussen skips down and pushes it to long on for one.
This is fuller in length, around middle. Temba Bavuma eases it to long on for a run.
Tossed up, on middle. Rassie van der Dussen clips it to mid-wicket for a single.

DRINKS! South Africa did lose three wickets in the Powerplay but Rassie van der Dussen and Temba Bavuma have steadied the ship since then. They require just 30 runs now and would look to quickly wrap things up without any further hiccups. Mahedi Hasan (1-0-8-1) comes back on.
Length ball, outside off. Temba Bavuma drives hard but straight to the cover fielder. 30 runs needed from 60 balls.

Bavuma shuffles across, Shoriful Islam sees it and bowls it wide outside off. Bavuma leaves it alone thinking that it is a wide. The umpire does not call it a wide as Bavuma had moved across a tad too much.
Back of a length, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen hangs back and pulls it along the ground to rotate the strike.
Short of a length, around off. Rassie van der Dussen stays back and dabs it back onto the deck.
Length ball, angling in from middle. Bavuma flicks it to wide of deep mid-wicket and collects three runs.
Shoriful Islam (3-0-10-0) to bowl out.
Back of a length, on middle. Rassie van der Dussen tucks it to the leg side for one.
A quicker ball, on middle. Temba Bavuma defends it out.
Flatter ball, on off. Temba Bavuma pushes it back to the bowler.
SIX! BANG! A half-tracker, around off. Temba Bavuma rocks back and pulls it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Good running! Tossed up, on off. Temba Bavuma stays back and taps it past point. He comes back for the second run and gets it easily.
Flatter ball, on off. Temba Bavuma pushes it to cover off the back foot.
Nasum Ahmed to operate now.
Tossed up, around off. Rassie van der Dussen eases it to long off for a single.

Good-length ball, on off. Temba Bavuma pushes it back to the bowler. Taskin Ahmed collects the ball and scores a direct hit at the striker's end. Bavuma is well inside the crease. Taskin Ahmed finishes with figures of (4-0-18-2).
Good-length ball, around off. Temba Bavuma blocks it off the back foot.
FOUR! Glorious! Length ball, around off. Temba Bavuma comes forward and drives it handsomely past mid off to collect a boundary.
Good-length ball, angling in from off. Temba Bavuma skips down and blocks it in the end as he is cramped for room.
Full ball, outside off. Temba Bavuma drives it to mid off, off the front foot.
Short of a length, jagging back in from middle. Temba Bavuma tucks it to the leg side off the back foot.
Length ball, outside off. Temba Bavuma prods and carves it past covers. Mahedi Hasan gives it a chase and pushes the ball inside by diving in front of the ropes. The batters take three runs.
Back of a length, on off. Temba Bavuma stays back and blocks it awkwardly in the end.
Length ball, around off. Temba Bavuma stands tall and pushes it to cover.
Back of a length, around leg. Rassie van der Dussen tucks it to the leg side for a single.
Length ball, on off. Rassie van der Dussen prods and pushes it to mid off.
Good-length ball, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen lets it be.

BEATEN! This is top-class bowling from Taskin Ahmed and he is keeping South Africa's batters on their toes! Length ball, jagging back in from outside off. Temba Bavuma looks to block but the ball sneaks through his bat and pad. Excellent over from Taskin Ahmed comes to an end. End of the Powerplay, South Africa are 33-3.
Temba Bavuma walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! Excellent bowling from Taskin Ahmed and he is rewarded with another wicket! Good-length ball, just outside off. Aiden Markram looks to poke at it and it takes the outside edge, the ball goes straight to Mohammad Naim at first slip who takes a sharp catch. South Africa lose their third wicket inside the Powerplay.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Naim b Taskin Ahmed

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR BYES! WOW! That came back in sharply and Aiden Markram had absolutely no clue about that delivery and he loses his bat as well. Length ball, outside off, jagging back in sharply. Aiden Markram looks to block it but he misses and it beats the keeper as well. The ball races away to the fence. Markram loses his bat too. It slipped out of his hands and almost rattled the stumps.
Length ball, angling in from middle. Aiden Markram clips it to mid on.
Length ball, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen skips down and drives it towards mid off. Mahmudullah there runs to his left and keeps it to just one.
BEAUTY! Good-length ball, outside off, shaping away late. Rassie van der Dussen looks to poke at it but the ball zips past his outside edge.
Taskin Ahmed (2-0-13-1) is back on.
Loopy ball, on middle. Aiden Markram nudges it to mid-wicket. 8 runs and a wicket from the over.
Aiden Markram is the new man in.

OUT! TIMBER! Mahedi Hasan has the last laugh! Gets spanked for a couple of boundaries and responds back. That was a floated delivery, on leg. Quinton de Kock gives himself some room to play it on the off side. He misses it completely. The ball skids on and goes through his bat and pad and disturbs the wooden furniture behind him. South Africa lose their second wicket.
On middle, played to the off side.
FOUR! Shot! Floats it up, on middle, Quinton de Kock plays a reverse sweep. The ball races past the point fielder for another boundary. Two in a row!
FOUR! Beautifully played! Lovely sound too off the bat! Tosses it up, outside off. Quinton de Kock makes room, opens up his arms and lofts it over extra cover for a boundary.
Loopy ball, on middle. Quinton de Kock defends it back to the bowler.
Mahedi Hasan comes to bowl.
On a good length, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen dabs it down to the point fielder.
Short of a lenght, outside off, at 133 kph. Rassie van der Dussen stands up on his toes and cuts it to cover.
FOUR! In the gap! Once again, on the pads. Rassie van der Dussen works it to deep square leg. Times this one nicely and fetches himself a boundary.
On the pads, Rassie van der Dussen clips it to mid-wicket.
On middle, Rassie van der Dussen tucks it on the leg side.
Short of a length, on off. Rassie van der Dussen hops and defends it on the off side.
FOUR! Put away! Short ball, on middle. Quinton de Kock pulls it to deep backward square leg for a boundary. No chance for the fielder to cut it off. The ball races away to the fence in a jiffy.
Good-length ball, outside off. Quinton de Kock drives but finds the cover fielder again.
Length ball, outside off. Quinton de Kock drives it but straight to cover.
On a length, on leg. Quinton de Kock clips it to deep square leg. He comes back for the second run and gets it comfortably.
God-length ball, on off. Quinton de Kock defends it to mid on.
Fuller in length, on off, at 146 clicks. Rassie van der Dussen drives it to extra cover for a single.
Leg bye! Good-length ball, down leg. Rassie van der Dussen misses his flick and gets hit on the pad. The ball rolls away to the leg side for a leg bye!
Good-length ball, around off. Rassie van der Dussen skips down a bit and defends it out.
Wide! Islam errs in line and spills this one down leg. Rassie van der Dussen misses his flick. Wided!
Short of a length, outside off. Quinton de Kock guides it to third man for a single.
Leading edge, but safe! Back of a length, around off. Quinton de Kock is early in his flick and it takes the leading edge which falls just short of the point fielder.
Back of a length, outside off. Quinton de Kock cuts but finds the point fielder.
Good-length ball, around off. Quinton de Kock blocks it off the back foot.
Rassie van der Dussen is the new man in. Also, Shamim Hossain to bowl from the other end.

OUT! LBW! Bangladesh get an early breakthrough. Just the start they needed. Taskin Ahmed bowls a length ball, nipping back in sharply, on off. Reeza Hendricks looks to defend but misses. He gets rapped on the pads. Another loud shout from Ahmed and this time the umpire doesn't hesitate to raise his finger. Reeza Hendricks asks Quinton de Kock whether to review or not and he doesn't. That looked dead front. Reeza Hendricks will have to walk back to the pavilion.
Back of a length, on off. Reeza Hendricks defends it right under his eyes.
FOUR! Reeza Hendricks is off the mark with a boundary! Overpitched delivery, outside off. Hendricks places it in the gap through extra cover and gets a boundary.

Good-length ball, on leg, at 142 kph. Reeza Hendricks looks to tuck it away but gets hit on the pads. Loud appeal from Taskin Ahmed for an lbw but the umpire is unmoved. Bangladesh do no take a review.  Probably going down the leg side with the angle.
Good-length ball, on off, at 144 kph. Reeza Hendricks knocks it back to the bowler.
Fuller in length, on off. Quinton de Kock drives it to mid off for a single.
WIDE! Taskin Ahmed starts with a length ball, down leg. Quinton de Kock looks to flick but misses. Wided.
